facts: Which butterfly is Tamil Nadu's official State Butterfly (தமிழ் மறவன்)?
Tamil Nadu adopted the Tamil Yeoman (Cirrochroa thais) in 2019.
Look for orange wings crossed by dark markings and a silvery-pale underside band.
Which butterfly species appears at the heart of The Nature and Butterfly Society (TNBS) emblem?
Papilio crino, the Common Banded Peacock, features emerald-green wings with a turquoise median band and serves as TNBS's emblem.
An emerald-green swallowtail whose caterpillars feed on East Indian Satinwood.
How many butterfly species are documented in Tamil Nadu's state butterfly checklist?
TNBS records 329 species across 6 families (325 validated in Tamil Nadu, with 4 awaiting confirmation).
The count increased from 323 in 2015 and 328 in 2022 to 329 in 2025.
Which two recent species additions expanded the Tamil Nadu checklist to 329 species?
Elymnias hypermnestra and Cigaritis meghamalaiensis (described from Meghamalai in 2023) brought the state list to 329.
One feeds on palms around Chennai and Sirumalai; the other is a newly described Theni hill silverline.
Which butterfly has a white underside with black markings and a bold orange hindwing border?
The Red Pierrot (Talicada nyseus) breeds inside succulent Kalanchoe leaves.
Often seen fluttering gently near courtyard Kalanchoe plants.
Which large swallowtail is Tamil Nadu's largest butterfly and a Western Ghats endemic?
Troides minos reaches up to 190 mm wingspan with golden-yellow hindwings.
Also known as the Sahyadri Birdwing.
Which species was observed migrating in thousands during the June 2024 Mudumalai survey?
TNBS and Forest Department teams documented thousands of Common Grass Yellows (Eurema hecabe) moving in Mudumalai.
A small yellow pierid with two dark spots inside its underside forewing cell.
Which two Danainae groups make up the vast directional butterfly migrations between Yercaud and Coimbatore?
Blue Tigers, Dark Blue Tigers, Common Crows, and Double-branded Crows drive Tamil Nadu's biannual migrations.
Monitored by TNBS since 2013 across Salem, Tiruppur, and Coimbatore.
What AI identification platform created by a TNBS member identifies 923+ Indian butterfly species from photos?
Butterfly Vision (butterflyvision.in), built by Theivaprakasham Hari, runs Western Ghats and All India deep learning models.
Integrated right into our AI Identify page!
Which Schedule II mistletoe butterfly was a highlight of the Dec 2024 Pachamalai Hills survey?
Rachana jalindra was recorded in healthy numbers in thick Pachamalai forest.
Its underside is cleanly split between snow-white outer half and golden-brown inner half.
Which skipper featured in Pattampoochi has pale yellow-green caterpillars feeding on Urena lobata?
Caprona ransonnetti rests with spread wings and contrasts a mottled brown upperside with a chalky-white underside.
Belongs to Pyrginae, spread-winged flats and angles.
Which butterfly's early stages and Cynodon dactylon (Bermuda grass) host plant were first documented in India by TNBS authors in 2021?
Hari Theivaprakasham, Hari Ramanasaran, and Appavu Pavendhan published Ypthima ceylonica's immature stages in Journal of Threatened Taxa.
A bright white-hindwinged ringlet common on short lawn grasses.
Which member of Lycaenidae in Tamil Nadu has carnivorous caterpillars that prey on mealybugs?
Spalgis epius larvae eat mealybugs instead of plant leaves, and its pupa resembles a miniature monkey face.
Its silvery-grey underside is scribbled with fine wavy brown lines.
How many walking legs does a brush-footed butterfly (Nymphalidae) use when perching?
Nymphalid forelegs are reduced to short brush-like structures, so they stand on their middle and hind pairs.
That anatomical quirk gives brush-footed butterflies their English family name.
Which mimicry pair involves a distasteful red-bodied swallowtail and a harmless female morph?
Female Common Mormons (romulus form) mimic the distasteful Crimson Rose (Pachliopta hector).
True Rose swallowtails have bright crimson-red bodies; mimics keep black bodies.
What host plant do caterpillars of the Grass Demon (Udaspes folus) feed on?
Grass Demon larvae roll leaves of turmeric (Curcuma) and ginger (Zingiber) plants.
Look for a dark skipper with a big white central patch on the hindwing.
Which detail turns a butterfly photograph into a reliable scientific sighting record?
Date and locality allow citizen-science records to track seasonality, range shifts, and migrations.
TNBS's checklist relies on verified place-and-date observations.
Which Nilgiri Biosphere tiger reserve recorded 185+ butterfly species across 8 ranges during the June 2024 monsoon survey?
Sixteen teams covering 8 ranges recorded 185+ butterfly species in Mudumalai Tiger Reserve in June 2024.
Located at the Tamil Nadu-Kerala-Karnataka tri-junction.
Which family is Tamil Nadu's smallest butterfly family with just two Plum Judy species?
Riodinidae has 2 entries in Tamil Nadu: Straight Plum Judy (Abisara echerius) and Plum Judy (Abisara bifasciata).
Shade-loving maroon-brown butterflies that turn abruptly right after landing.
Which butterfly's female closely mimics the orange-and-black Plain Tiger while its male is jet-black with violet-white ovals?
Hypolimnas misippus displays dramatic sexual dimorphism and Batesian mimicry.
Females lack the cluster of tiny black dots at the hindwing centre found on true Plain Tigers.
Which migratory painted nymphalid was spotted near Sivaganga in June 2026 press reports?
Vanessa cardui is a celebrated long-distance migrant tracked in Tamil Nadu hills and plains.
Orange-pink wings with black, white-spotted forewing tips.
